title: Record the writes that leave register 292 at 2
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 20575, register 292 holds `2` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- Event 16016 copies register 356 at `1`. Event 19164 adds `-2` times register 295 at `-1/2` and leaves `2`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The writes that produce register 295 are not traced.
